cases.summary: Real ovis-terminal serve runs a shell as t1; an interact viewer types go, the program draws a 3-chunk Kitty f=100 PNG and, one row below, a sixel, and the viewer receives both live; it closes its stream (attach.close), a second viewer attaches interact, and its paint re-sends both sequences byte-identical (SHA-256), Kitty before sixel, followed by one graphics_replayed record naming raw offsets 2 and 142 with nothing released, then input_ready.

cases.summary: --inject {"graphics":{"scroll_rows":"200"}}: after drawing the same two images the program prints 200 lines, scrolling both off the 24-row screen; the first viewer sees both live, closes, and a second viewer's paint re-sends neither sequence, followed by one graphics_replayed record that re-sends nothing and lists both released image offsets (2 and 142) with reason scrolled_out.
